card.name: Patients in dosage section headings
card.fires_on: The word patients (or a subsection heading word like Prevention) at the start of a Dosage and Administration section, especially in 'Select patients for treatment' and 'dose for patients with'.

modes.label: Subsection heading word
modes.description: The first word of a numbered dosage subsection title.

card.plain: It marks the word 'patients' at the opening of a label's dosage section, where the text says who should be treated.
